contracts.design-v1: You are the software architect. From the requirements, decide the service interface. Return ONLY a JSON object with keys: "id_type" ("string" or "integer": the type of document identifiers), "operations" (list of operation names), and "status" (an object mapping each situation to an HTTP status code: "created", "exists", "missing", "invalid_id", "archived_put").
contracts.design-v2: Act as the architect of this service. Read the requirements and specify its interface as a single JSON object (no prose) containing "id_type" (either "string" or "integer"), "operations" (the operation names) and "status" (HTTP status code for each of the situations "created", "exists", "missing", "invalid_id", "archived_put").
contracts.impl-v1: You are the programmer. Implement the service as one Python class named DocumentStore, in memory, standard library only, no input/output. Methods: create(doc_id, body) -> int; read(doc_id) -> always a 2-tuple (status, body or None); put(doc_id, body) -> int; archive(doc_id) -> int; list() -> sorted list of all identifiers, archived ones included. Use exactly the status codes of the design. Identifiers of the wrong type are invalid. Return ONLY one ```python code block.
contracts.impl-v2: Write the implementation: a single Python class DocumentStore kept in memory (standard library only, no I/O) with create(doc_id, body) -> int, read(doc_id) -> always a 2-tuple (status, body or None), put(doc_id, body) -> int, archive(doc_id) -> int and list() -> sorted list of all identifiers (archived included). Status codes must be those of the design; identifiers of the wrong type are invalid. Answer with one ```python code block only.
contracts.tests-v1: You are the test engineer. Write a Python test suite for the service: at least three functions named test_<something>(make), where make() returns a fresh DocumentStore. Use plain assert statements, no imports, no I/O, and only the public methods create, read, put, archive and list(). Cover every requirement, including the archived-document rule, duplicate creation, missing documents and that put changes the body. Return ONLY one ```python code block.
